renames.role_description: Three independent static heuristics for detecting a rooted device: PATH 'su' file search, Build.TAGS 'test-keys' substring match, and a hard-coded list of known SU-related file paths.

method_renames.evidence: Iterates System.getenv("PATH").split(":") looking for 'su' file existence — canonical path-based root check.
str.contains("test-keys") on Build.TAGS — distinctive AOSP debug-build signature commonly used for root detection.
Hard-coded list including /system/app/Superuser.apk, /system/xbin/daemonsu, /system/etc/.installed_su_daemon, /dev/com.koushikdutta.superuser.daemon/. All known SU-related artefacts.

renames.evidence_summary: Three sibling boolean methods, each clearly recognisable as a root-detection heuristic. Caller pattern (MainActivity invokes m2a() || m3b() || m4c() → "Root detected!" dialog) confirms intent.
